verdict.rationale: Jira exposes REST APIs (jira-docs-1, jira-comm-20) and has an official Atlassian MCP server (jira-probe-3) enabling agentic access, but there is no evidence of official language SDKs, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (jira-probe-1, jira-probe-2), undermining structured, AI-friendly SDK development.
